0022600031.text: The Pelicans (4-4, on a four-game winning streak and 11th in the West) host the Timberwolves (6-3, on a two-game winning streak and 7th in the West) in their ninth game of the season, a Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. New Orleans will be without Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 132-126 loss in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
